assumptions.text: A teaching architecture derived from the evidence base will beat the textbook's unit shape. The incumbent is the prescribed book's own organisation, a stronger baseline than 'legacy' implies — the clean-room design may rediscover much of it, and that is a legitimate outcome rather than a failure. What would make it a failure is rebuilding the same grid under new names at the cost of a full rewrite

The extensive-reading effect survives unsupervised self-study at all. research/ielts/09 §2.2 carries this as an explicit GAP — the evidence base is almost entirely classroom-mediated, and the accountability moderator suggests self-study is the HARDER case, not the easier one. Supported by no evidence and contradicted by none. This is the central risk of the whole product

A narrative spine carrying the syllabus raises sustained unprompted use. The extensive-reading evidence does NOT warrant this: the story slots total 11,479 words across a year, roughly one graded reader, and volume was never analysed in the meta-analysis. The sourced warrant is instead the topic-lexis discount (07 §2.2a [S]) - a fixed cast, setting and vocabulary is its strongest instantiation, worth about a 1,000-word level of coverage. Marker honestly downgraded from [V 3-0] to [S] by making the claim fit the evidence

Grade-8 work built this way develops genuine IELTS precursors, and IELTS-format practice from the start is right for a learner already studying IELTS. Two limits stand: the official alignment bottoms out at band 4.0 = B1 with no band for A2 or A1, so the claim cannot be checked at her level even in principle; and §3.3 records that preparation can move scores without moving proficiency, which is precisely the outcome we would be unable to detect

MEASURED, no longer inferred: of 2,164 marked items in units/*.md, 1,851 are coursework and 313 simulate a test; only 275 of 1,357 free-text keys (20.3%) use official key grammar; and markAnswer() never reads skill=, so test severity is applied to all coursework. Three mechanical classes of legitimate variant are rejected at 41/62 = 0.661. The residue needing genuine semantic judgement is ~7% of items. What remains assumed is that re-authoring that residue toward closed answer spaces is preferable to judging it - not that the 93/7 split is real, which is counted

Spelling-variant acceptance is tractable and bounded - the missing -yse and single-l British classes are two rules and one list. What is NOT tractable is global lexical or grammatical variant matching, which manufactures false positives in exactly the exercises that test the distinction; those belong in individual keys. The assumption is that per-key authoring covers the real cases

'Reuse the current story mode structure' means reusing its data model, authoring vocabulary and cast manifest while rebuilding the renderer to that structure — not porting the existing comic-geometry code, which the brief rules out. If the operator meant literally keeping the existing implementation, the app-foundation milestone changes materially

The learning experience can be built and judged with placeholder art, provided every drawable thing is a declared slot and the missing set is inventoried, so drawings added later simply work. Operator-decided. The counter-case stands: a reading adventure whose art is dashed boxes may not be the product, in which case the verdict measures something she will never use
A thin end-to-end slice is enough to judge the loop, provided it spans at least two consecutive units of work — a return is where the north-star metric lives, and one session cannot show it

Marking placed after the reading, as the accountability step, preserves the thread better than marking inline at the beat. Operator-decided and unvalidated against the alternative; no tournament will run on it
One learner's response generalises far enough to justify the build. Accepted knowingly; commercial scale-up is out of scope, so this charter is not asked to generalise

Deleting tools/, docs/ and the generated site while keeping curriculum/sgk/, research/, data/dict/, data/cast.json and art/ is the right cut of 'remove the current code'. Those kept assets are what the rebuild exists to deliver better

Some form of accountability exists that this specific thirteen-year-old tolerates and does not experience as homework. This is not a missing feature; it is the difference between d = 0.51 and d = 0.01, and the documented risk runs both ways — detail-testing quizzes after reading are recorded as demotivating and avoidance-inducing

A browser-delivered app with local persistence is sufficient; nothing observed requires a native app or a server. There is one learner and no server-side backup, so her record lives on one device and losing it loses the product

The weekly shared Saturday session plus weekday solo use is the real usage pattern, and the Saturday session is what makes the weekday record worth keeping. It also supplies the independent measure E6 requires before any gain may be called a proficiency gain. Unvalidated: whether the Saturday session actually happens every week, and whether it stays a conversation rather than becoming an inspection

constraints: The content floor is ALL ~400 prescribed targets across six families. The METHOD and SEQUENCE are free — the 12-unit x 7-lesson shape is dead — but no target may be dropped, because the learner still sits Vietnamese school examinations on this book. check_coverage.py reports and exits 0, so this needs a real gate: a large rewrite can go fully green while quietly deleting required curriculum
No IELTS band number is ever output — not a score, prediction, progress dial, badge or goal. No half-band. Label by CEFR if a level must be named at all, and never on the learner's page (A1, A2, A3)
No hours-to-band promise of any kind (E7). No presentation of our own practice-test gains as proficiency gains without an independent measure (E6)

An exercise a key can settle is a committed, marked attempt, never a reveal-and-self-mark — learners cannot self-assess accurately (Phakiti 2016, N = 376, up to 93% miscalibrated on hard items). A retake is a new attempt, never an edit; no averaging across attempts, no trend claim (C1–C5, E3, E9, §4.4)
A false negative is the worst failure this system can produce. She is alone and has nobody to appeal to, so a correct answer marked wrong teaches her that the right answer is wrong. The gate is zero

Automated judgement stays inside the defensible set: obligatory-context accuracy on named structures, error-free sentence density, presence or absence of named discourse moves, paraphrase identification. Never a holistic band, never Coherence & Cohesion, Task Response, Lexical Resource precision, 'flexibility', or pronunciation (D9, §4.2, §5.4)
Any automated scorer reports its disagreement rate with human judgement, or reports nothing scored at all (D10), and is adversarially tested before shipping (D11)
Any extensive-reading provision limits text choice to the learner's level AND includes an accountability step (B9) — the difference between d = 0.51 and d = 0.01
The interface explains nothing about itself. No criterion names, no evidential markers, no CEFR labels, no citations, no accounts of evidence
No Speaking rubric or Speaking feedback tool (D7)
No Vietnamese pronunciation tooling beyond 07 §8.3's three permitted targets, and no claim that any of it raises a score or transfers to spontaneous speech (B7)
Nothing recorded upstream as a GAP or [X] may be asserted — and neither may its negation (A10, G6)
Responsive web app: one codebase serving phone and desktop, designed at 360 px and grown, fast enough to be measured rather than asserted. Browser only, no native app

Art is added later and must simply work: every drawable thing is a declared slot with a placeholder behind it, the missing set is inventoried in writing, and dropping a file into a slot requires no code change
Story mode is reused structurally and is not reworked in this scope. The 'animating novel' direction is captured as a planned later scope

Any visual or geometric claim is measured in a real browser against real layout boxes. A DOM shim that does no layout cannot see a balloon covering a face — 41% of the previous build's runtime was guarded that way
Every sweep emits a coverage count beside its result; zero rendered and zero defects are otherwise identical output
The kept assets — curriculum/sgk/, research/, data/dict/, data/cast.json, art/ — are read-only inputs. Regenerating them is years of work and would be an unforced loss
The repository path contains a space (/Users/liemnguyen/Per/English 8). Every path passed to a shell or harness is quoted
Each architecture step gets an adversarial second-brain review before it is frozen, and the verdict is committed as an artefact
charter.desired_outcome: A responsive web app - phone and desktop, fast, offline-capable - that a child opens on a weekday with no help and learns English from, and that gives her uncle something real to look at on Saturday. Underneath it, three architectures designed rather than inherited: (1) a TEACHING architecture whose atomic unit is a short session rather than a lesson, delivering every prescribed target while free to sequence and pace them as the evidence directs; (2) a MARKING architecture that is local, synchronous and offline - question types engineered toward closed answer spaces, official key grammar carrying legitimate variation, two severities so coursework is not marked with test severity, and a near-miss state so a nearly-right answer is neither credited nor accused; (3) an APP architecture with real module boundaries, content as data, versioned local state, and asset slots that make a drawing work the moment it is dropped in. Her underlying English improves, which is the honest route to any IELTS improvement; the app never outputs, predicts or promises a band.
kill_criteria: The learner stops opening it unprompted for two consecutive weeks, with content available and no external cause

The ~400 prescribed targets cannot be placed in the new shape without recreating the 12 x 7 grid under new names — in which case the honest conclusion is to keep the textbook's curriculum organisation and rebuild only the delivery, at a fraction of the cost
The false-negative rate cannot be driven to zero on the built slice, or can only be driven to zero by accepting wrong answers as right
Accountability cannot be built into a form this learner tolerates. Per the evidence that is not a missing feature; it is the difference between a medium effect and no effect at all

The teaching architecture cannot carry curriculum without degenerating into a lesson with a story printed above it — the current build's failure mode, and repeating it means the rebuild bought nothing
Honest marking cannot be preserved on the new surface without the experience degrading into a test

The app cannot be made fast enough on a mid-range phone to be opened casually — if it is slow to open, it will not be opened unprompted, and the north-star metric is lost before any pedagogy is tested
charter.problem: One Vietnamese grade-8 learner, ~13, studies English largely alone. The operator (her uncle) sits with her one morning a week; the rest of the week she is on her own with a phone and nobody to ask. The existing build delivers the prescribed curriculum completely but is the wrong artefact three ways over, and two of the three are now measured rather than asserted. FIRST, it organises learning as the textbook does - twelve units of seven lessons - which is the publisher's convenience rather than an evidence-derived teaching sequence. SECOND, its marking produces false negatives, and the defect is worse than reported: traced against the live engine, key 'yes' with the answer 'yes, it is' returns {ok:false, why:'two'}, so she is not merely marked wrong, she is authoritatively told she wrote two answers in one gap when she wrote one. The same trace rejects 'cannot stand' for "can't stand", '3 hours' for 'three hours', 'the bracelets' for 'bracelets', and the entire -yse and single-l British spelling classes (analyse/analyze, enrol/enroll, skilful/skillful, fulfil/fulfill). Across units/*.md there are 2,164 marked items; only 275 of 1,357 free-text keys (20.3%) use the official key grammar that would fix this. And markAnswer() never reads skill=, so IELTS Listening severity is applied to all 1,851 grade-8 coursework items as well as the 313 that actually simulate a test. THIRD, engineering ran ahead of content: 41% of the runtime is comic geometry guarded only by string-matching, one 4,702-line script loads on all 101 pages, and 29 of 32 art assets are placeholders. The rebuild exists to fix three architectures - teaching, marking, and app - while losing none of the content.

readiness.designer: Direction is unusually well specified and has just been sharpened: research/prototype/story-english-brief.md carries scope, eight non-negotiables, metric candidates and kill criteria; .atelier/rules/design-foundations.md has been rewritten from the shipped starter template to this product's actual UI bar. Newly settled: content floor of ~400 targets, method free, IELTS format from the start, art later behind slots, story mode reused not reworked. Still open and now the first milestone's job: what the atomic unit of work is, and what accountability looks like to this learner. Not ready: no visual language exists for the new surface.
readiness.developer: Stack deliberately unchosen — the previous build's defining failure was one 4,702-line script with no module boundary, so boundaries should be chosen before frameworks. Inputs are stable and machine-readable (targets.json, data/dict/, data/cast.json). Two risks: every geometric or performance claim needs a real browser harness, which is new work rather than ported work; and the LLM marking fallback introduces latency, cost, failure and privacy considerations the previous build never had.
readiness.owner: Settled: all ~400 targets kept, method free; IELTS format from the start; design-to-avoid marking with LLM only where unavoidable; art inventoried and deferred; story mode reused; second-brain review by subagent since codex is blocked by a workspace spend cap. Outstanding: no LLM provider chosen and the privacy position on a minor's written work leaving the device is not settled; whether the clean-room design's conclusion is binding if it contradicts the incumbent; and what happens to the rest of the year if the thin slice succeeds. The north-star metric depends on the owner personally making a weekly observation.

in: The teaching architecture, designed clean-room: the atomic unit of work is a SESSION, not a lesson and not a chapter; what a session contains, how sessions chain, and what decides what she does next when she opens the app - a queue, not an index

A story spine extended to enough chapters to carry real reading volume, since the existing four story slots total 11,479 words across a whole year - roughly one graded reader - which is not extensive reading by any reading of the evidence
A vocabulary track OUTSIDE the stories: the 325 distinct lexis strings taught as collocations with audio, pre-taught before the text that uses them, on a fixed-interval ladder
Placement of the non-lexis targets - grammar, pronunciation, everyday-English functions, culture blocks, writing genres - into the new shape, gated rather than hoped for

The marking architecture: closed-answer-space question types; official key grammar with optional tokens, alternates and either-order pairs; two severities keyed to whether an item simulates a test or is coursework; a near-miss third state; and an appeal control that records her disagreement without re-marking
British and American SPELLING variants, including the -yse and single-l classes the current engine misses; lexical and grammatical variants only per-key, never globally
An authoring-time LLM that proposes key variants for human acceptance and pre-generates per-item explanations shipped into the page - never a runtime scorer

IELTS PRECURSOR SKILLS from the start - synonym recognition under search conditions, confidence calibration with feedback, obligatory-context accuracy on named structures - with format familiarisation as a one-off orientation per question type
Weekday activity tracking, and a weekly shared surface that makes the week legible on Saturday without becoming a score
Spaced retrieval on a fixed-interval ladder, evaluated against delayed retention
Support that appears where the reader stalls and withdraws afterwards, in Vietnamese, once per item
The app foundation: responsive phone and desktop, fast, offline-capable, module boundaries, content as data, learner state persisted locally and versioned
An asset-slot interface and a written inventory of every missing art asset, so drawings added later simply work with no code change
A thin end-to-end slice built for real, spanning at least two consecutive sessions
An adversarial second-brain review on each architecture step, its verdict recorded as a committed artefact
out: ANY runtime LLM call that decides, adjudicates or overrides a mark. D10 requires an automated scorer to report its disagreement rate with human judgement or report nothing scored at all; with one learner and no human rater no such rate can exist, so the LLM may not score. This also removes the latency, cost, offline-fragility and privacy problems entirely
Sending the learner's written work to any third-party API. She is a minor; every defensible LLM job runs at authoring time over authored text on the author's machine

Global lexical or grammatical variant matching (shop/store, have you got/do you have). Applied globally these manufacture false POSITIVES in exactly the exercises that are about the distinction; they belong in individual keys

Reworking story mode's rendering. The existing story structure is reused; the 'animating novel' direction - colourful animated characters moving through the adventure - is documented and planned for a later scope
Producing the 29 missing art assets. They are inventoried and slotted; drawing them is later work
Aligning the sequence to her school's examination calendar. The operator has chosen to optimise purely for learning
A streak mechanic. The north-star metric IS unprompted return; a streak optimises that metric directly and destroys its interpretability, so no streak ships before a clean baseline exists
Commercial features - accounts, payment, multi-tenancy, third-party authoring. One learner
Delivering grades other than 8. The shape must not ASSUME grade 8; it need not DELIVER another grade
Any Speaking rubric or Speaking feedback tool (D7)
Any IELTS band number, half-band, dial, predictor, or hours-to-band promise (A2, A3, E7); any claim that our own practice-test gains are proficiency gains absent an independent measure (E6)
Any Vietnamese pronunciation tooling beyond 07 8.3's three permitted targets, and any claim it raises a score or transfers to spontaneous speech (B7)
Porting tools/, docs/ or the generated site. Reference for intent only
A native app - nothing observed requires leaving the browser
Regenerating the kept assets: curriculum/sgk/, research/, data/dict/, data/cast.json and art/ are read-only inputs
Re-running the pedagogy research. research/ielts/ is source-verified; it is queried via index.jsonl, never read wholesale

charter.target_users: One named learner: the operator's niece. Vietnamese, grade 8, ~13, phone-first, and already studying IELTS separately, so the design targets a motivated learner above the pure-beginner case. The usage rhythm is now known and is structural: the operator and the learner sit together ONE MORNING A WEEK (Saturday) and use the app; on weekdays she uses it alone, unsupervised. That splits the product into two surfaces with different jobs - a weekday self-study loop, and a weekly shared surface where what she did during the week is visible to both of them. It also means her weekday activity must be tracked, because the Saturday session is where that record is read. The population this must NOT silently design for is the adult test-taker on whom almost the entire IELTS-preparation evidence base is built. Commercial scale-up is out of scope; n = 1 is a strength because the north star can be observed weekly rather than modelled.
charter.user_access_plan: The learner is the operator's niece and is directly reachable, so this charter needs no recruited study. The app is installed on her phone and she uses it unsupervised. The operator observes weekly and records two things: days she opened it without being asked (returns_unprompted) and sessions she started (sessions_unprompted). The app keeps a local open-log that corroborates the observation but never establishes it, because no log can distinguish a prompted open from an unprompted one. Nothing about the observation is surfaced in the interface, and she is never shown a band, score or composite. Three honest limits: n = 1; the observation is single-blind at best because the observer is the person who wants it to succeed; and novelty cannot be separated from effect in the first weeks — which is why the kill criterion is stated in consecutive weeks rather than sessions. She is also studying IELTS elsewhere, so any change in her IELTS performance has a second cause we do not control and cannot subtract.

goal.text: A phone-first English self-study app for one Vietnamese grade-8 learner where a story read chapter by chapter is the spine and the syllabus is carried by it, built on a clean-room curriculum design derived from the research base rather than ported from the current system

approach_candidates.name: Queue-first: the app opens on what is due
approach_candidates.summary: The home surface is the review queue; the story is a slot inside a session rather than the navigation model. Priority: due reviews, then the next unmet target whose prerequisite lexis is at 'seen', then reading. There is no 'next lesson' screen at all - this is what makes the freed sequence actually free rather than rhetorically free. Strongest fit to the spaced-retrieval evidence (09 §2.1, [V 3-0] across 48 experiments, N = 3,411); weakest pull for unprompted return, because a queue is a chore surface and the north-star metric is whether she opens it unasked.

approach_candidates.name: Story-first: the app opens on the next chapter
approach_candidates.summary: The narrative is the navigation model; due reviews and the vocabulary track surface after or around the chapter. Strongest fit to the operator's thesis and to unprompted return, and the honest warrant is the topic-lexis discount (07 §2.2a [S]) - a fixed cast, setting and vocabulary is its strongest instantiation, worth roughly a 1,000-word level of coverage. Risk: scheduling becomes subordinate to narrative order, and a target's delayed check lands when the story reaches it rather than when memory needs it.

approach_candidates.name: Alternating: story days and drill days
approach_candidates.summary: Sessions alternate in kind rather than mixing - some are pure reading, others pure retrieval. Simplest to schedule and to reason about; the sharpest test of whether the story is carrying the syllabus or merely alternating with it. Risk: it makes the seam between story and syllabus visible, which is precisely the 'lesson with a story printed above it' failure the rebuild exists to avoid.

approach_candidates.name: Woven: one session, four fixed slots
approach_candidates.summary: Every session has the same four slots in the same order - due reviews, meet ~6 new collocations with audio, read one text, produce one accounted-for output. Fixed shape means she always knows what she is in for, which matters for a 13-year-old alone. Warranted slot by slot: F7/F3 collocations with audio, B8 lexis pre-taught before the text that uses it, B9 accountability. Risk: a fixed shape can feel like a worksheet, and four slots may overrun a weekday evening.

# The executable gate for story-english. One shared file gates the goal; every
# milestone declares this same scenario set, and `prototype check` runs all of
# them. Each scenario emits its ATELIER_METRIC lines on stdout as bare numbers,
# with the unit carried in the metric id.
#
# Every sweep emits a coverage count beside its result. A harness that renders
# nothing and a harness that finds no defects produce identical output
# otherwise, and one is a pass while the other is broken.
#
# These are real gates. Until the milestones build the harnesses they fail,
# which is correct: making them green is the work, not a precondition to it.

checks:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Curriculum and content integrity. Every prescribed target is placed, and no
  # target has its encounter, its production and its delayed check in the same
  # session — E5 restated as architecture, and the mechanical guard against
  # degenerating into a lesson with a story printed above it.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - name: build
    kind: build
    setup: "[ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund 2>/dev/null || true"
    timeout_seconds: 600
    command: |
      set -e
      node harness/coverage.mjs
      node harness/support.mjs

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Marking correctness, gated as a PAIR. A false-negative gate alone is
  # trivially satisfied by an engine that accepts everything, so false
  # positives gate with it and neither number means anything without the other.
  #
  # Baselines on the engine being replaced: false negatives 41/62 = 0.661 over
  # three mechanical variant classes; key_variant_coverage 275/1357 = 0.203.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - name: marking
    kind: smoke
    setup: "[ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund 2>/dev/null || true"
    timeout_seconds: 600
    command: |
      set -e
      node harness/marking.mjs

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # A real browser, real layout boxes, a real session run start to finish at
  # phone width. This exists from milestone one deliberately: the build being
  # replaced asserted its stylesheet as a string and grepped its own source for
  # function names, so renaming a function failed the gate with a
  # pixel-identical picture while a balloon landing on a face passed.
  #
  # Also carries the surface scan — no band number, half-band, band promise,
  # hours-to-band claim, CEFR label, criterion name or citation reaches the
  # learner's page.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - name: session
    kind: interaction
    setup: "[ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund 2>/dev/null || true"
    timeout_seconds: 900
    command: |
      set -e
      node harness/session.mjs
      node harness/surfaces.mjs

fabrication_surfaces.mitigation: Closed and probed. Writing all 400 targets against a session id that does not exist scored 400/400 before the fix and scores 0/400 with 400 dangling after it. coverage_min 400 on items_swept proves the sweep enumerated every target rather than a convenient subset.
fabrication_surfaces.surface: The placement map claims a target is covered by naming it in content/placement.json, while nothing in the app ever delivers it.

fabrication_surfaces.mitigation: The gate reads the data and nothing else: coverage.mjs resolves every target against content/placement.json and content/sessions.json, and the session interaction check drives one of those same sessions in a real browser at 360 px under CPU throttle. There is no artefact the gate cannot execute.
fabrication_surfaces.surface: The architecture ships as a design document no machine reads, and the data beside it is decorative.

fabrication_surfaces.confirmation_needed: A person reads the session shape at the boundary: the printed units-per-session distribution and the session list, answering whether the sequence is genuinely freed or a renamed grid. No headless gate can settle a kill criterion stated as a judgement about shape.
fabrication_surfaces.mitigation: Partly closed: cross_unit_sessions counts sessions drawing on more than one source unit, which the grid has exactly zero of by construction, and the gate now fails the probe it previously passed. That is a floor which refutes the LITERAL grid; it is not evidence the architecture is good, and one token cross-unit session would clear it. The units-per-session distribution is printed beside the number.
fabrication_surfaces.surface: The 12 x 7 grid rebuilt under new names — a kill criterion. Eighty-four unit-local sessions score a perfect 400 with every other gate green, which was verified by writing exactly that map.

fabrication_surfaces.mitigation: The milestone's own task ledger requires the chosen figure be stated as an engineering assumption rather than a finding. Nothing on a learner-facing page may explain itself at all, which the surfaces scan enforces across every page on every boundary.
fabrication_surfaces.surface: Session duration and the atomic unit of work are engineering assumptions with no evidence behind them, and could be presented in the milestone's output as findings.

honesty_review.question: Where can this milestone's surface show something it invented, or claim something it didn't measure?

milestones.objective: Replace the textbook's 12-unit x 7-lesson organisation with a session-based teaching architecture derived from the evidence base, expressed as machine-readable data rather than a design document, and prove it by running one real session in a real browser at 360 px. milestones.risk: This is the highest design risk in the product and everything downstream is decoration if it is wrong. Two specific failure modes: recreating the 12x7 grid under new names at the cost of a full rebuild, which is a kill criterion; and producing a design artefact no machine reads, which drifts from the build the day after it is written. approach_directives.directive: The home surface is the review queue; the story is a slot inside a session rather than the navigation model. The narrative is the navigation model; due reviews and the vocabulary track surface after or around the chapter. Strongest fit to the operator's thesis and to unprompted return, and the honest warrant is the topic-lexis discount (07 §2.2a [S]) - a fixed cast, setting and vocabulary is its strongest instantiation, worth roughly a 1,000-word level of coverage. Risk: scheduling becomes subordinate to narrative order, and a target's delayed check lands when the story reaches it rather than when memory needs it.

Sessions alternate in kind rather than mixing - some are pure reading, others pure retrieval. Simplest to schedule and to reason about; the sharpest test of whether the story is carrying the syllabus or merely alternating with it. Risk: it makes the seam between story and syllabus visible, which is precisely the 'lesson with a story printed above it' failure the rebuild exists to avoid.

variants.terminal_reason: no progress for 3 cycles; still failing: build, marking — 1 of 4 cycle(s) reaped by the wall-timeout watchdog (worker silent/unresponsive)

tasks: Design the session: what an atomic unit of work contains, how long it is, and what decides what she does next. The evidence gives no session duration - state the chosen figure as an engineering assumption, not a finding

Size the story: how many chapters, how long each, and what each carries. The current four slots total 11,479 words across a year, roughly one graded reader, which is why the spine must be extended to carry real volume
Design the vocabulary track outside the stories: 325 distinct lexis strings as collocations with audio (F7, F3), pre-taught before the text that uses them (B8), on a fixed-interval ladder
Build the target placement map: encounter, production and delayed check for each of the non-lexis targets; lexis routes to the trainer rather than into lessons

Implement the invariant as a build gate: no target may have its encounter, its production and its delayed check in the same session. This is E5 restated as architecture and it is what mechanically prevents 'a lesson with a story printed above it'

Fixed-interval ladder only. F4 permits uniform intervals and forbids claiming expanding ones are superior - two independent meta-analyses find them equivalent (g = 0.034, n.s.). F5: err long. E5: evaluate on delayed retention, never same-session

Stand up the real-browser harness at 360 px and desktop, measuring from real layout boxes. This exists from milestone one deliberately - the previous build's jsdom gates asserted a stylesheet as a string and grepped the app's own source for function names — DONE: harness/{lib,coverage,marking,session,surfaces,support}.mjs with Playwright+Chromium, verified against the real build (first paint 1079ms at 360px/4x throttle, js_bytes 448092, 18/46 false negatives reproduced incl. the why:"two" misdiagnosis)

Establish the app skeleton the architecture needs: content as data, module boundaries, versioned local state, declared art slots with placeholders behind them, and the missing-asset inventory written out
Run one complete session end to end in the browser harness at 360 px
Adversarial second-brain review by an opus subagent (briefed to disagree; codex is not used) of the architecture before the boundary; commit the verdict as an artefact
